whenToUse: There's time left in the period.
A pause is offered alongside cancellation.
whenNotToUse: You'd hide cancellation behind several screens (see the roach motel).
You'd block it by making a reason mandatory.
You'd fade the cancel button and stress only the pause.

alternatives.name: Roach Motel
alternatives.reason: The dark pattern of making cancellation hard.

alternatives.name: Forced Continuity
alternatives.reason: The dark pattern of charging quietly after a free trial.

accessibility: The reasons are radio buttons, with the legend saying they're optional.
The cancel and pause buttons sit side by side at the same size.
The result is read with role="status".
